sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

The adenovirus type 4 and type 7 vaccine is indicated only for military personnel between 17 and 50 years of age. No information is available on the use of adenovirus type 4 and type 7 vaccine during breastfeeding or its excretion in human milk. In general, vaccines given to a nursing mother do not affect the safety of breastfeeding for mothers or infants. However, the product labeling recommends using caution in nursing mothers, because live virus is shed for 28 days following vaccination.
